- Legal entity name (exact as W-9 / tax filing)
- Remittance address for invoices (street, city, postal code, country)
- Preferred invoice routing (email + any accounting portal link)
- AP contact name, title, email, phone
- Tax ID / W-9 (or equivalent)
- Bank details for ACH (if you want ACH enabled) or confirm wire-only

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form_OrionBio.pdf (PDF, 1 page)

Next steps on our side once we have the info: create vendor master record, set payment terms (net 30 unless otherwise agreed), map to Redwood ERP vendor code, and send a test PO.

Appreciate the fast reply and the attachments. A couple quick follow-ups before we mark the vendor record active: 
1) Beneficial ownership / UBO declaration — do you have a standard form or statement? For audit we need a completed UBO attestation for any corporate vendor over our threshold.
2) If you want ACH enabled, we require a bank verification step (we either accept a micro-deposit confirmation or a bank letter). Which would you prefer?
3) Do you have a preferred PO to invoice mapping (PO number on invoice required? invoice reference format?)

We will treat payment terms as net 30 by default. If you need alternative terms, share the approval contact. Once we have UBO + bank verification, Ben will enable the payment method and I will finish vendor activation.
